sentences.text: Morphological analysis shows the bird was most similar to the modern thick-billed raven.
It is the earliest known occurrence of African large-billed ravens in the area.
The fossil was recovered from the Taurida Cave deposits in Crimea.
It was described in a paper titled “A Fossil Thick-Billed Raven from the Lower Pleistocene of Crimea”.
The study was authored by N. V. Zelenkov, who formally named the species in 2026.
The remains date to the Early Pleistocene, a segment of the Pleistocene epoch.
During that time the bird inhabited the central Crimean peninsula.
